title: Check an attached evidence record
responsibility: Validate the original record and its manifest identity and file declarations before projecting it.

inputs.name: hubRecordJson.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes expected to contain strict UTF-8 JSON.

inputs.name: hubAttachedRecord.result
inputs.description: Attached result with manifest, retained record.json bytes, validated file facts and existing problems.

outputs.name: hubRecordJson
outputs.description: Parsed JSON value, or undefined for invalid encoding/JSON.

outputs.name: hubAttachedRecord
outputs.description: Copied result with validated record when available and accumulated problems for invalid record structure, seal mismatch, identity mismatch or undeclared/mismatched files.
